title: haplophyllum obovatum
intro: Haplophyllum obovatum, commonly known as the Egyptian spurge, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. It is valued for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating skin conditions, wounds, and other infections. The therapeutic actions of Haplophyllum obovatum include analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in managing pain, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
